Name: Amariah, Chief Priest
Summary: Amariah the chief priest was set by Jehoshaphat over all matters of the LORD in the Jerusalem court of judges.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat charged that Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD, and Zebadiah for all the king's matters.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Zebadiah, Son of Ishmael
LifeLesson: Judgment belongs to the LORD, so judges must act in His fear, faithfully, with a perfect heart.
